name: 馬尚智
objective:
1. Introduction
2. Linear block codes 
3. Cyclic codes 
4. Convolutional codes 
5. Coded modulation
課程進度(1-16週):
I. Introduction (1st wk)
II. Linear block codes (2nd wk ~ 5th wk)
1.	Maximum likelihood decoding
2.	Standard array
3.	Syndrome decoding
4.	Hamming codes
5.	Reed-Muller codes
III. Cyclic codes (6th wk ~ 8th wk)
1.	Introduction to algebra
2.	Encoding
3.	Error-trapping decoding
4.	BCH codes
IV. Convolutional codes (9th wk ~ 13th wk)
1.	Structural properties
2.	Distance properties
3.	The Viterbi algorithm
V. Coded modulation (14th wk ~ 16th wk)
1.	Set partitioning
2.	Block coded modulation
3.	Multistage decoding
4.	Trellis coded modulaion
VI. Flexible Learning (17th wk ~ 18th wk)
